description: Read one documentation page in full, as current markdown. Take `lib` and `path` verbatim from a search_docs hit (or from the docs://{lib}/index resource): paths are matched exactly and their shape differs per library, so never guess or adapt one. Call search_docs first when you do not have a path yet.

lib.description: The library name, as search_docs returned it

path.description: The page path, as search_docs returned it (e.g. /api/hooks/use-frame)

name: get_page_content
title: Get Page Content
